title: Nous Core Catalog
description: Nous domain components for the F092 companion app. v1 subset: approval gates, action review, stat tiles, key-value tables. Mixed per-surface with the A2UI basic catalog.
instructions: Use ApprovalPanel for pre-execution escalations and ActionReviewCard for post-hoc action review. Pair them with basic-catalog Buttons for the verbs. Bind long prose through the data model, not literals, so updates can patch it.

ApprovalPanel.description: Escalation panel: what is being asked, the risk, and the recommendation. Options render as separate basic-catalog Buttons below the panel.

summary.description: What is being proposed and why.

recommendation.description: The option id the agent recommends.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

ActionReviewCard.description: Post-hoc review of an action Nous already took: what it did, why, what it cost, and whether it can still be undone.

title.description: One-line description of the action taken.

why.description: The reasoning that led to the action.

compensation.description: Object with revertible (boolean), handler (string or null), note (string). Drives whether a Revert affordance is rendered.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

StatTile.description: A single labeled statistic with optional delta and intent coloring.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

KeyValueTable.description: Two-column key/value table bound to a data model array of {key, value} objects.

rows.description: Path to an array of objects with string properties key and value.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

DecisionCard.description: One decision under review: description, calibrated confidence, stakes/category badges, current outcome.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

ConfidenceMeter.description: Horizontal 0..1 confidence bar with the numeric value.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

MemoryGraph.description: Interactive memory-graph view: nodes/edges bound from the data model, radial layout around a focus node; tapping a node asks the agent to expand its neighborhood.

nodes.description: Path to an array of {id, type, label}.

edges.description: Path to an array of {source, target, relation, weight}.

focusNodeId.description: Node id at the center of the layout.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

DagGraph.description: Wave-layout DAG view: nodes colored by status, edges as arrows.

nodes.description: Path to an array of {name, status, node_type}.

edges.description: Path to an array of {from, to}.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

AppHeader.description: Micro-app header: title, subtitle, and the mandatory freshness stamp rendered client-side from composedAt (amber past staleAfterS).

composedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the app was composed — bind it to the data model (e.g. /meta/composedAt) so app.refresh can update the stamp without touching components. Mandatory (grammar rule).

staleAfterS.description: Seconds after composedAt before the stamp degrades to amber.

note.description: F096: a data-reach line under the freshness stamp, e.g. 'data through 2026-09-01' — the stamp says when the app was composed, the note says how far the data reaches. Bind it (e.g. /meta/reach) so refresh can restamp it.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

AppFooter.description: Micro-app footer: enumerated refine options, refresh, and close. Refine/refresh call agent functions over /a2ui/call; close is the app's only action-router verb.

refineOptions.description: Array of {id, label} refine options, validated server-side against the surface's app_spec.

agentActions.description: F092.2: server-stamped agent-action buttons ({id, label} only — the stored instruction never reaches the client). Each tap posts app.act {actionId}, validated server-side against the surface's app_spec.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

Section.description: Titled content block of a micro-app. No anonymous blocks (grammar rule). provenance='model' marks a subtree whose data no registered source produced — rendered amber.

child.description: Component id of the section body.

provenance.description: Where this section's data came from. 'model' renders the amber model-supplied treatment regardless of age.

caption.description: F096: right-aligned qualifier in the section head — source attribution ('Garmin', 'retrieval_log'), the comparison window, a count. Put attribution HERE, not in the title.

layout.description: How the section's child lays out (default stack). hero = large/primary for visual hierarchy; grid-2/grid-3 = N-column grid over the child's items; cards = auto-fit grid of ≥220px cards for MetricCard/ScoreCard grids; rail = horizontal scroll; accordion = collapsed until the user taps the title (long secondary detail, never the headline). grid-N and cards reshape a DIRECT Column/Row child (a list of cards, or a repeat template of one card). The renderer owns the CSS.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

StatRow.description: Horizontal row of up to four StatTiles at the top of a micro-app.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

Timeline.description: Time-ordered event list: the Briefing archetype's backbone.

items.description: Path to an array of {at, label, detail?, flag?} — at is a preformatted time string, flag=true highlights the row.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

Sparkline.description: Inline single-series trend line: no axes, no grid, no point labels. Bind `path` to a series-shaped source ({kind:series, points:[{t,v}]}). The renderer owns scale, domain, gaps and colour; you pick a `tone`.

path.description: REQUIRED. Data-model path to a series object. No literal fallback — a chart with no data is meaningless.

label.description: Short caption shown beside the line.

tone.description: What the series MEANS (default neutral). The renderer maps it to a theme token — you never pick a colour.

trendline.description: F096: draw the renderer-owned rolling mean as the main line with the raw series faint behind it (default false). The window size is not yours to pick.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

LineChart.description: Multi-series line chart with axes and a legend. Bind `path` to a multi-series source ({kind:series, points:[{t, <key>:number,...}], keys:[...]}). Max 4 series (renderer-enforced).

path.description: REQUIRED. Data-model path to a multi-series object.

key.description: A numeric key present in every point.

series.description: 1-4 series to draw, each naming a numeric key in the points. Colour is renderer-assigned from the series ramp or the tone.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

BarChart.description: Categorical bar chart, y-axis always zero-based (a truncated bar axis is how a chart lies). Bind `path` to a series object where each point's `t` is a category label and `v` its bar value.

path.description: REQUIRED. Data-model path to a series object.

orientation.description: Horizontal reads better for long category names (default vertical).

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

MetricCard.description: F096: one metric's full story inside a section — label, headline value (+unit), a tone-coloured delta pill, the comparison caption, an optional embedded trend sparkline and a footnote. The VALUE is never coloured; tone lands on the pill and the trend (a number is a fact, a direction is an opinion). Values arrive PREFORMATTED (the StatTile contract): the agent already chose the decimals and the unit; the renderer never rounds, re-signs or adds units. Use StatTile only for the ≤4 headline tiles in the StatRow.

unit.description: Rendered small beside the value, e.g. 'bpm'.

delta.description: The change pill text, preformatted, e.g. '↓4.3 bpm · improving'.

tone.description: What the delta MEANS (default neutral): colours the pill and the embedded trend, never the value. Either a literal from the enum or a {"path": …} binding (so each card of a repeat template carries its own record's tone); the renderer maps an unknown resolved value to neutral.

caption.description: The comparison line under the value, e.g. '68.9 → 64.6 (28d avg, n=28)'.

trend.description: Data-model path to a series object ({kind:series, points:[{t,v}]}) — a BARE STRING like Sparkline.path (not {"path": …}), relative to the item inside a repeat template. Omit it for a count: a count is not a series, and a blank path is rejected.

trendline.description: Draw the renderer-owned rolling mean over the faint raw series (default false). The window size is not yours to pick.

footnote.description: Small right-aligned line under the trend, e.g. 'last 2026-09-01'.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

ScoreCard.description: F096: a verdict on an objective with its evidence — title, an uppercase status pill, an optional headline value, evidence rows each carrying their own tone, and an italic note. Tone drives the top rule and the pill. A card with no value is legal: the verdict plus evidence is the content. Values arrive PREFORMATTED (the StatTile contract): the agent already chose the decimals and the unit; the renderer never rounds, re-signs or adds units.

status.description: The verdict word(s), rendered as an uppercase pill, e.g. 'on track' / 'slipping'.

tone.description: What the verdict MEANS (default neutral): colours the top rule and the status pill. Either a literal from the enum or a {"path": …} binding (so each card of a repeat template carries its own record's tone); the renderer maps an unknown resolved value to neutral.

caption.description: The comparison line under the value.

items.description: Path to an array of {label, value, tone?} evidence rows — value preformatted (e.g. '↓0.4 kg'), tone ∈ neutral|ok|warn|crit colours that row's value.

note.description: Italic muted footer — what this card's numbers can and cannot tell you.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

DeltaList.description: F096: ranked movers — one row per metric that moved: label · tone-coloured delta · from → to. An EMPTY list is a state, never a blank block: it renders emptyText in italics ('no significant adverse moves' is the good news). Values arrive PREFORMATTED (the StatTile contract): the agent already chose the decimals and the unit; the renderer never rounds, re-signs or adds units.

rows.description: Path to an array of {label, delta, from?, to?, tone?} rows in the order to show — delta/from/to preformatted strings, tone ∈ neutral|ok|warn|crit.

emptyText.description: Shown muted italic when rows is empty (default 'nothing to report').

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

DataTable.description: F096: a real table over record rows — columns is a LITERAL array (never a binding) naming which record fields to show; align:end right-aligns in tabular figures (numbers, dates); secondary marks a de-emphasised supporting column. Max 6 columns (a phone-width table); long cells wrap, the table never widens the page. No sorting, filtering or cell formatting. Values arrive PREFORMATTED (the StatTile contract): the agent already chose the decimals and the unit; the renderer never rounds, re-signs or adds units.

columns.description: 1-6 column specs, in order: key = the record field to show, label = the header text.

align.description: end right-aligns in tabular figures — use for numbers and dates (default start).

secondary.description: A de-emphasised supporting column (default false); the renderer owns the treatment.

rows.description: Path to an array of record objects; each column's key is read from every row.

emptyText.description: Shown muted italic when there are no rows.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.

ChipRow.description: F096: a wrapping row of labelled status chips — data freshness, lane health, environment flags. Each chip: uppercase muted label, tone-coloured value, muted detail. Values arrive PREFORMATTED (the StatTile contract): the agent already chose the decimals and the unit; the renderer never rounds, re-signs or adds units.

items.description: Path to an array of {label, value, detail?, tone?} chips — value preformatted (e.g. 'today', '8d ago'), tone ∈ neutral|ok|warn|crit colours it.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.
